<!-- pr-reviewer: 83ec867ee46e508a67cede40b76ac36e5012f2b6 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The wire flag permits only Wire EDM when the script has no explicit `serves` list. An explicit list still controls the machine kinds. The tests check acceptance, refusal of other kinds, strict boolean values, and the names in the refusal message. This meets issue #1335.

Local results after a trial merge with `upstream/main` at `e2f012e90c3174fb308344e5122bb39e70531d90`:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Build app unit tests and five selected integration suites (`cargo test --no-run`) | Pass |
| App unit tests | 308 passed, 1 ignored |
| `post_serves_kind` | 6 passed |
| `post_serves_plasma` | 1 passed |
| `posting` | 17 passed |
| `sodick_wire_post` | 9 passed |
| `wire_post` | 12 passed |
| App Clippy, all targets, warnings denied | Pass |

This is a SAFETY-tier review because the change controls which post script can write NC output for a machine. I repeated two mutation checks locally:

1. Remove the new wire branch: the acceptance test fails at `posting_serves/tests.rs:7`.
2. Permit all machine kinds in the wire branch: the same test fails for `Mill` at `posting_serves/tests.rs:15`.

After I restored the code, all three new tests passed. The worktree has no source changes.

Requested before merge: none.

No golden files changed. No UI files changed. The integration tests passed with the existing NC goldens. I did not test a physical EDM control. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
